Precipitation of Nanocrystalline CeO2 Using Triethanolamine

Recordpati-2009-xps-fit
Evidence typeprocedure

Download record JSON ↓

Complete supplied four-page main and four-page matched SI read and independently audited. Canonical/reader, molecular, apparatus and symbolic product-context audits passed. Three alcohol-specific precipitation routes, eleven supporting procedures and five observation records remain separate. As-prepared whole-powder identity is unresolved despite local CeO2 microscopy; calcination, DLS and XPS exposure histories retain their own scopes. Source conflicts are preserved. No atomic model, exact structure-recipe pair or new training task is admitted.

Original characterization and property figures

05

Chemical intuitionReferenced context and interpretation

Mechanistic interpretations and related literature remain separate from the experimental training labels.

Complete source reader and limitations ↗Source document review
06

Evidence and trainingTask eligibility follows source review and sample linkage

precursor selectionExcluded

No identified synthesis precursor set.

partial protocolExcluded

Preserve missing fields; this is literature protocol supervision, not a complete SOP.

size conditioned recipeExcluded

Requires an explicitly linked quantitative diameter; author-derived size remains labeled.

exact structure recipeExcluded

Requires measured sample coordinates, explicit recipe linkage and no unresolved required fields.

success predictionExcluded

Literature and heterogeneous historical failure markers do not establish a calibrated success model.

optical outcomeExcluded

Published numeric optical benchmark with explicit row linkage. Failure placeholders are excluded from continuous targets.

Unresolved information

  • Records and context counts do not count independent physical batches.
  • Three alcohol substitutions, as-prepared/calcined powders, solution DLS and XPS exposure states remain distinct.
  • As-prepared local CeO2 crystallites do not establish pure whole-powder composition.
  • No qualified atomic model, exact recipe–structure pair, automatic same-aliquot join or training admission.
  • See source acquisition facts and missingness G4

Source distinctions and conflicts

  • C6: SI prose/table print Ce3d7/2 for v and3d5/2 for u. Do not silently substitute a conventional label.
  • C4: Mainp3 reports less than15min; SIcaption/p3 approximately15min and SIp2 exactly15min wording. Keep separate source assertions.
